name: Tax Voucher 6
definition: Specifies tax vouchers in the framework of a corporate action event.

TaxVoucherReference.name: Tax Voucher Reference
TaxVoucherReference.definition: Unique reference for the tax voucher required by the relevant tax authorities to ensure that any claim relating to this particular tax voucher cannot be duplicated.

TaxReclaimDocumentationReference.name: Tax Reclaim Documentation Reference
TaxReclaimDocumentationReference.definition: Unique reference assigned by the account owner to the tax documentation sent to the account servicer for processing.

BeneficialOwnerReference.name: Beneficial Owner Reference
BeneficialOwnerReference.definition: Unique reference identifying the beneficial owner the refund applies to, as assigned by the account owner to the tax documentation sent to the account servicer for processing.

TaxVoucherPresenceRule.definition: At least one of TaxVoucherReference Or TaxReclaimDocumentationReference Or BeneficialOwnerReference must be present.

TaxReclaimDocumentationReferencePresence.definition: If TaxReclaimDocumentationReference is present then BeneficialOwnerReference must be absent.

BeneficialOwnerReferencePresenceRule.definition: If BeneficialOwnerReference is present then TaxReclaimDocumentationReference must be absent.
